content.text:
The app now starts in light mode. Before, it copied the OS setting, so anyone with a dark system got dark mode. The change is in `web/src/App.tsx:54`, and the typecheck passes. I havent opened it in a browser yet.

There's one catch. The old code saved the theme to localStorage on every load, not just when someone clicked the toggle. So anyone who already opened the app on a dark OS has `dark` saved and will still see dark mode. New visitors, and anyone who clears their storage, get light.

I can fix that if you want. The simplest way is to only save the theme when the user picks one, and rename the storage key so the old automatic saves get ignored. That would also reset anyone who picked dark on purpose, but that should be a small group.

Nothing is committed yet. Say the word and I'll put it on a branch and open the PR.
